text_block_list.text:
Argh, what the?! What is this awful
pain?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Has my mask gotten smaller? Did I yell
too much
when I was watching that last
wrestling match?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ugggh... Whatever it was, it's got my
head
chiming like a ring bell...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Do you want to take the day off?

text_block_list.text:
Ni de pedo! I'm not about to let a
headache get
the best of me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She stops shouting after that, but her
headache
isn't going away anytime
soon...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
